newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-BOURSE DECIDES ON THREE NEW ENTRIES.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-BOURSE DECIDES ON THREE NEW ENTRIES.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Tueday that its board meeting decided to list the stocks of three new companies on the bourse.
The stock exchange also said that block trading and central market trade would be allowed in the following shares from June 9:
- Dzukijos Statyba, 719,010 ordinary shares with a face value of one litas.
- Vilkma, 1,248,028 ordinary shares with a face value of one litas.
- Dvarcioniu Keramika, 6,666,138 ordinary shares with face value of five litas.
